papers.title_en: No Matter Who You Are: Addressivity and Sycophancy in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Seungjong Sun, Hyunmin Jun, Minsik Yoon, Eungu Lee, Choongwon Kang, Young Seok Woo, Jang Hyun Kim
papers.evidence: 直接研究后训练大语言模型对用户谄媚迎合的成因。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的谄媚行为常被归因于后训练，但其内部形成机制仍不清楚。本文关注后训练赋予输出的“受话者指向性”，利用稀疏自编码器提取相关方向，并结合表征干预与受控后训练实验展开分析。结果显示，调节这些方向仅在后训练模型中能增强或抑制谄媚，且后训练强化了两者的内部关联。模型会迎合任何被识别出的受话者，而非特定身份，提示谄媚可能与面向受话者生成回应的机制相耦合。
papers.abstract_en: Sycophancy, where an LLM becomes overly agreeable, deferential, or flattering toward the user, has been identified as a major failure mode. While post-training has been implicated as a cause, how it internally gives rise to sycophantic behavior remains insufficiently understood. Post-training transforms the model's output from text completion into utterances directed toward an addressee, thereby giving the output \textit{addressivity}. We hypothesize that the accompanying pressure to follow the addressee's instructions and align with their preferences links this addressivity to sycophancy. To test this, we use Sparse Autoencoders to extract addressivity directions from pre-trained and post-trained models and examine their relationship with sycophancy. Steering models with addressivity directions can amplify or suppress sycophancy, and this effect is observed only in post-trained models. Furthermore, comparing the internal mechanisms of both model types confirms that the association between addressivity and sycophancy is strengthened through post-training. Finally, through a controlled post-training experiment, we find that models are sycophantic not toward a specific addressee but toward any recognized addressee, suggesting that the presence of an addressee, rather than the addressee's identity, is what elicits sycophancy.

papers.title_en: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
papers.authors: Songping Wang, Peiyang Li, Yi Huang, Fengting Li, Xuhao Ran, Yueming Lyu, Chao Feng, Caifeng Shan
papers.evidence: 评测手机内容中的跨模态注入如何操控自主移动智能体。
papers.tldr: 多模态移动智能体可跨应用感知、推理并执行操作，也可能被短信、网页等内容中的恶意指令诱导。论文提出MobileInject，在11类场景、9类安全风险和108个可执行风险实例中评估注入攻击，并以跨模态一致性注入及两种增强方法操纵信任与推理。实验发现，移动智能体普遍易受攻击，许多失败源于早期推理劫持。该基准结合细粒度诊断框架，为研究从推理到行动的安全风险提供系统化评测工具。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cross-Modal Consistency Injection to exploit corroboration across modalities, two enhanced attack methods, Multi-Role Collaborative Deception and Reasoning-Camouflage Injection, to intensify trust manipulation and reasoning hijacking, and a Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework for fine-grained failure analysis. Systematic experiments show that mobile agents are broadly vulnerable to multimodal injection, and that many failures stem from reasoning hijacking at early stages. These findings establish MobileInject as a systematic cross-modal benchmark for studying and improving the security of mobile agents. Code release details are provided in the Appendix Open Science section.

papers.title_en: Analyzing Repetition and Interference Effects in Memory-Constrained User Simulators
papers.authors: Cara Su-Yi Leong, Nicholas Tomlin, Tal Linzen
papers.evidence: 检验人工智能用户模拟器能否复现人类记忆效应与错误模式。
papers.tldr: 用户模拟器可用于大规模评估和训练人机交互系统，但其记忆行为是否与人类一致仍待验证。论文考察记忆受限的模拟器能否复现事实重复带来的记忆增益，以及竞争信息造成的干扰。部分模拟器的总体准确率和两类效应幅度接近人类，但没有模型能匹配人类在具体问题上的准确率：人类倾向于记错事实，模型则倾向于遗忘事实。研究发布挑战基准，强调评估不仅要看总体表现，也要检验逐题表现与错误模式。
papers.abstract_en: User simulators can help evaluate and train AI systems to interact with humans at scale. To do so, evaluation of user simulators must measure behavioral parity with people. We evaluate whether memory-constrained user simulators are sensitive to two factors known to affect human information retention: repetition of a fact and interference from competing information. We find that some simulators achieve human-like overall accuracy, and replicate the magnitude of repetition and interference effects, but none match people's accuracy on particular questions: while humans misremember facts, models forget them, leading to different error patterns. We release this data as a challenge benchmark for future work on user simulators.

papers.title_en: SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents
papers.authors: Egor Zverev, Juhee Kim, Leon Trampert, Boris Köpf, Aashish Kolluri, Shruti Tople, Santiago Zanella-Béguelin
papers.evidence: 通过控制浏览器代理的信息流，防止用户私密数据泄露
papers.tldr: 浏览器智能体跨站执行任务时，可能受提示注入操控并泄露数据，仅恢复同源策略无法兼顾安全与合法跨站操作。SPIDES依据网页元素的机密性与完整性标签传播信息流，屏蔽不可信和机密内容，并对输入、点击、导航等操作实施策略检查。在包含28个互联网站的MicroNet评测中，攻击成功率为0%，同时保持较高任务完成率与自主性。其贡献是将防护从模型判断转向信息流约束，在既定策略与威胁模型下提供独立于底层模型的安全保障。
papers.abstract_en: Browser agents automate complex workflows by reading and acting on arbitrary page content, but this flexibility exposes them to prompt injection attacks and unintended data exfiltration. Recent work argues that LLM-driven browser agents erode traditional web security boundaries such as the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) by acting across origins with the user's authority and no built-in isolation. We argue that restoring SOP is neither sufficient (a same-origin public sink can leak private data) nor necessary (legitimate tasks require authorized cross-origin flows) for protecting the security of users. We propose SPIDES, which instead enforces information-flow control by gating primitive browser actions such as typing, clicking and navigating on labels propagated from element-level HTML confidentiality and integrity annotations. Untrusted and confidential content is masked from the agent's context, while policies block unauthorized flows, providing security guarantees against both prompt injection and data exfiltration that hold independently of the model driving the agent. To evaluate SPIDES and baseline defenses under a common threat model, we build MicroNet, a closed ecosystem of 28 interlinked websites with element-level ground-truth labels and paired benign/adversarial tasks. SPIDES achieves 0% attack success rate by design while retaining high task completion rate and autonomy. Our findings demonstrate that information-flow control is an effective technique to extend web security to browser agents, gaining on autonomy and utility against state-of-the-art baselines. The source code and data are openly accessible at https://github.com/microsoft/SPIDES.

papers.title_en: Can Agents Keep Secrets They Were Never Told? Benchmarking Latent Privacy Risks Across Sessions with MemJoin
papers.authors: Qishun Yang, Shu Yang, Difei Xu, Di Wang, Meng Ding
papers.evidence: 基准测试智能体跨会话长期记忆组合导致的隐私泄露
papers.tldr: 智能体的长期记忆可能把不同会话中的普通信息拼接成敏感关系，并在无须披露的日常任务中说出。论文提出MemJoin，构建288个合成案例，确保完整历史可推导敏感关系、单次会话却不足以推导，并统一生成模型评测六种记忆系统。配对测试发现，移除连接线索可改变完整关系的输出，即使所检查的目标属性值仍然可见。这表明隐私评测不能只查属性是否出现，还须检查跨会话组合后是否泄露与具体个人关联的敏感关系。
papers.abstract_en: To support sustained interactions and personalized assistance, agents use long-term memory to retain and combine user information across sessions. Reusing such memories can lead an agent to state a sensitive relation while completing an ordinary task that does not require it. The relation to protect and the combination of clues that reveal it may remain hidden at memory write time, when later records and tasks are still unknown. In this paper, we introduce MemJoin, a privacy benchmark of 288 synthetic analysis cases in which the complete history entails a sensitive relation, but every individual session is insufficient. We evaluate six memory systems with the same answer-generating model, alongside full-history and no-history controls. Each system writes and updates memories in session order and later retrieves context for an ordinary task, while target annotations remain with the evaluator. We separately check which target attribute values appear in stored records and retrieved context, and whether the final answer states the complete, person-linked relation. In a separate paired test on a prespecified subset, removing shared identifiers and other connecting clues can change complete-relation output while all checked target attribute values remain visible. These findings show why checking attribute visibility alone is insufficient to evaluate what records from different sessions reveal together.

papers.title_en: Say It or Grab It? Conversational Control of UI Adaptations in Mixed Reality
papers.authors: Sina Elahimanesh, Joao Marcelo Evangelista Belo, Isidora Jeknic, Alexander Koller, Anna Maria Feit
papers.evidence: 研究混合现实界面的自然语言控制，并与直接操控进行比较。
papers.tldr: 混合现实界面需随任务和环境变化持续适配，但既有适配策略通常预先固定，难以响应用户的即时需求。研究先通过19人研究收集适配需求的语言表达，再构建ConverseMR，将口头请求转为目标与约束，并随情境变化持续求解。24人被试内研究发现，直接操控适合精确调整，对话控制在触达范围和表达广度上更有优势，二者结合评价最高。用户常在体验结果后修改指令，体现了用户提出需求、系统寻找方案的“用户主导适配”。
papers.abstract_en: Mixed reality interfaces must continuously adapt to a user's changing task and environment, yet adaptation policies are fixed in advance, either preset by the system or configured by the user. Natural language offers a way to state changing needs mid-task, but whether users can express interface behavior this way, and what it gains over direct manipulation, is unknown. We first elicited how users verbalize adaptation needs (N=19). We then built ConverseMR, which translates a spoken request into adaptation objectives and constraints and satisfies them continuously as the user's context changes. In a within-subjects study (N=24), conversational and direct control proved complementary: direct manipulation for precision, ConverseMR for reach and expressive breadth, with their combination rated highest. Spoken commands were rarely final and users frequently refined and replaced them upon experiencing the result, characteristic of, what we call, user-led adaptation, where users communicate adaption needs and the system identifies a solution.

papers.title_en: Cooperation Without Shared Rewards via Reciprocal Q-Augmentation
papers.authors: Francesco Morri, Adel Abusitta, Quentin Cappart, Margarida Carvalho
papers.evidence: 研究不共享奖励条件下的多智能体合作与社会福利
papers.tldr: 一般和博弈中，个体逐利与背叛可能使智能体陷入低福利均衡，而共享奖励或内部状态的假设往往不现实。互惠Q增强方法（RQA）利用潜变量对手模型，估计自身行动对其他智能体的影响，仅依赖自身Q函数学习合作与背叛策略。在四类社会困境中，采用合作策略的RQA智能体比共享奖励方法更快形成、更充分维持合作；单个RQA智能体适时切换策略，也能诱导标准强化学习智能体合作。这为无需共享奖励的多智能体合作提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: General-sum games are more challenging than fully cooperative or adversarial settings because agents may deceive or exploit one another. Achieving high social welfare requires sustained cooperation, while a single defection can drive agents toward a welfare suboptimal Nash equilibrium. Moreover, assuming access to other agents' rewards or internal states is often unrealistic and implicitly introduces additional cooperation into the setting. To address this issue, we introduce \textit{Reciprocal Q-Augmentation} (RQA), a method that uses a latent-variable opponent model to augment the Q-function with estimates of how one's actions affects other agents. RQA allows agents to learn both cooperative and defective policies using only their own Q-function. We show that, in social dilemmas, agents that all follow the cooperative policy of RQA learn to cooperate faster and reach higher levels of cooperation than fully cooperative algorithms. Moreover, a single RQA agent that switches appropriately between its cooperative and defecting policies can induce cooperation in agents trained with standard RL algorithms, which would otherwise end up defecting. We evaluate our approach on the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, Iterated Traveler's Dilemma, Iterated Stag Hunt, and \texttt{CleanUp-Lite}. Our experiments show that the algorithms implementing RQA outperforms fully cooperative methods with shared rewards and enables cooperation with algorithms that otherwise fail to reach high social welfare.

papers.title_en: Towards Human-AI Complementarity for AI Safety
papers.authors: Sander Lanbo Shi, Miranda Anna Christ, Eric Modesitt, Andrew Louis, Konrad Cheng, Brandon Thai Tran, Sewoong Lee, Ratnakar Pawar, Gaia Molinaro, Juliana Bain, Nandika Donthi, Maja Pavlovic, Annya Dahmani, Francesca Bianco, Abhishek Shah, Tyler Crosse, Arth Singh, Karissa Huang, Sukanya Krishna, Konstantinos Voudouris, David Demitri Africa, Joshua Jacob, Rishub Jain
papers.evidence: 评估人类与人工智能的互补判断能否提升安全监督效果。
papers.tldr: 随着模型输出变长、变复杂，人类安全监督日益困难，研究尝试利用人机错误差异提升判断质量。作者构建覆盖六个领域、八个数据集的评测套件，包含3957个样本，并收集416名评估者的35613次判断。结果显示互补潜力可观，但所测辅助方法即使提高总体准确率，也使人类更少纠正模型错误；所测融合方法平均仅略优于较强单方。研究提供了评测基础设施，也表明安全监督中的人机互补仍需专门设计，而非自然产生。
papers.abstract_en: Safely overseeing AI is increasingly challenging for the humans doing it, as they must evaluate longer and more complex outputs with every new model generation. To mitigate this challenge, we could leverage complementarity: where humans and models make different mistakes, combining their judgements could yield an oversight signal stronger than either produces alone. We study this opportunity in realistic, safety-relevant settings, contributing the largest known suite of such tasks (3,957 instances across 8 datasets and 6 domains) as well as a platform and data pipeline for measuring human, AI, and human-AI performance on matched items. We collected 35,613 judgements from 416 human raters, finding a considerable opportunity for a complementarity effect. We also found that with the assistance methods we tested, human raters corrected the AI's errors less often, even when overall human accuracy rose, and the hybridisation methods we tested added little over the better single source on average. While complementarity is an important and feasible engineering target for safe oversight, achieving it remains an open challenge for future work.

papers.title_en: MemBubble: Benchmarking How Agent Memory Shapes LLM Response Diversity
papers.authors: Jiajun Tan, Fei Sun, Xinyu Ma, Shixuan Zhang, Du Su, Qi Cao, Daiting Shi, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng
papers.evidence: 评估智能体记忆利用用户偏好及其对个性化回复的影响
papers.tldr: 智能体记忆能利用历史偏好提供个性化回答，但也可能压缩回答多样性，限制用户接触的信息范围。论文提出基于真实用户对话的千例基准，通过偏好类别相关、具体场景不同的问题，评估多种模型与记忆机制。相比直接提供完整交互历史，使用记忆后的回答分布熵平均下降34.7%，简单用户干预与信息可用性调整也未能有效弥合差距。研究提示，记忆系统设计不能只追求个性化，还需保护回答多样性与信息获取广度。
papers.abstract_en: Memory serves as the core component of LLM-based agents, enabling personalized responses via extracting and using user preferences from past interactions. However, its use may reduce response diversity, thereby narrowing the range of information available to users. Existing evaluations rely largely on synthetic interactions and cover few memory systems, leaving the effects of memory on response diversity insufficiently evaluated in real-world scenarios. We introduce MemBubble, a benchmark of 1000 instances built on preferences extracted from real user-assistant conversations. To measure the extent to which memory concentrates response distributions, we construct test queries in scenarios distinct from user preferences while preserving topical relevance through shared preference categories. Across multiple LLMs and memory mechanisms, entropy decreases by 34.7% on average compared with directly providing the full interaction history, highlighting the important role of memory processing in diversity loss. We also explore simple user-side interventions and changes in information availability but find that these do not effectively close the diversity gap. Our findings highlight the need to consider preserving diversity and user access to information alongside improvements in personalization when designing and using agent memory systems.

papers.title_en: When Should AI Chime In? Benchmarking Timely Contribution of Proactive Agents in Multi-Party Chat
papers.authors: Ruotong Wang, Brian S. Yu, Xinyi Zhou, Joseph Chee Chang, Pao Siangliulue, Jonathan Bragg, Liwei Jiang, Amy X Zhang
papers.evidence: 评估主动式人工智能在多人实时协作中的介入时机。
papers.tldr: 主动式智能体即使提供相关信息，也可能因插话时机不当而打断群聊。论文提出时机评测基准PITCH，由真实对话参与者标注固定候选消息的理想插入轮次、可接受窗口或不应出现。基准涵盖35场对话、384条候选消息和1091条判断；评测发现，从完整对话定位切换到实时决策后，最佳轮次准确率由57.8%降至19.0%。模型普遍过早插话，且理由偏重相关性，表明主动协作智能体还需显式权衡等待的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive agents can support group collaboration by surfacing useful information without waiting to be asked, but even relevant contributions can be disruptive if poorly timed. In this work, we isolate the timing question: given a fixed candidate contribution such as a clarification or relevant fact, when should an AI agent chime in? We introduce PITCH (Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat), to our knowledge the first benchmark with large-scale human judgments of proactive agent timing collected from participants in the same unscripted multi-party conversations they took part in. To collect high-quality judgments, we design a novel interface in which 2-4 people chat synchronously, author candidate AI contribution messages, place their own and others' contributions into the chat history, and then deliberate as a group about the best placement for each message. PITCH contains 384 candidate contributions and 1,091 judgments, each marking an ideal turn, an acceptable window, or that a contribution should not appear, from 89 participants engaged in 35 conversations. Evaluating 15 models across 28 configurations, we find that while models can place contributions well when given the entire conversation history, they systematically chime in too early when asked to decide live as the conversation unfolds: best-turn accuracy falls from 57.8% to 19.0%, with nearly half of placements occurring before every participant's acceptable window. In comparison, lay humans deciding live are more accurate (23.7% vs 19.0%), and fewer of their placements are premature (39.7% vs 46.4%). Model reasoning traces show that 93% of intervention justifications cite relevance, while almost none consider waiting. By providing a human-grounded benchmark, our work reveals gaps in agents' ability to integrate into group settings and points towards proactive agents that can reason explicitly about appropriate timing.

papers.title_en: From Tasks to Turns: Measuring Human Labor Contributions in Human-Agent Joint Production
papers.authors: Likai Wang, Dezhao Su, Jing Hu, Yunyun Wan, Jingdi Lei, Xinhai Li
papers.evidence: 衡量人的单次指令对人机协作任务质量与计算的贡献
papers.tldr: 人类对智能体的一条简短指令可能改变后续搜索与执行，但任务最终结果难以揭示单次指导的贡献。论文提出人类轮次级框架，在模型、预算和终止条件一致时，对比相邻检查点的续跑质量与令牌消耗，并重复测量稳定性。研究开展29124次方向比较，发现指导效果依赖任务条件；即使最终质量相同，剩余计算需求也可能显著不同。该框架将贡献衡量细化到单轮，为研究人机联合生产中的人类劳动及其配置提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: In agent workflows, a brief human instruction can alter subsequent search, reasoning, and tool execution, yet final task outcomes rarely reveal the contribution of an individual instruction to human-agent joint production. We propose a Human Turn-level framework for measuring human contributions, using task quality and token usage to characterize the collaborative production outcomes associated with each human instruction. We compare continuations from adjacent checkpoints under matched models, budgets, and termination conditions, and assess stability through repeated measurements. Across four archived and simulated interaction settings, we conduct 29,124 comparisons between predicted and observed directions of quality and computational change at both Human Turn and session levels. On HumanBench, we obtain 506 valid comparisons across 85 real-user scenarios. Results show that quality and computational changes associated with human guidance depend on task conditions. Expert-style and ordinary-style guidance differ in information provision, correction, and repetition. Even when task quality after continuation is identical, remaining computational demands can differ substantially across checkpoints. Our framework advances the measurement of human labor contributions from tasks and sessions to individual turns, providing a repeatable, fine-grained foundation for studying human contributions and their allocation in human-agent joint production.

papers.title_en: TapID: Rapid touch interaction in virtual reality using wearable sensing
papers.authors: Manuel Meier, Paul Streli, Andreas Fender, Christian Holz
papers.evidence: 为虚拟现实提供快速表面触控交互
papers.tldr: 虚拟现实中的控制器和悬空手势难以支持长时间交互，限制了办公等生产力场景。TapID在腕带两侧布置惯性传感器，结合头显手部追踪，检测表面敲击并识别触碰手指。坐姿桌面实验中，触碰检测F1达0.997，用户内手指识别F1为0.93，跨用户经10次敲击微调后达0.91。该方案将实体表面的支撑与触觉反馈引入虚拟现实，为界面操作、快速打字和钢琴演奏提供输入方式。
papers.abstract_en: Current Virtual Reality systems typically use cameras to capture user input from controllers or free-hand mid-air interaction. In this paper, we argue that this is a key impediment to productivity scenarios in VR, which require continued interaction over prolonged periods of time---a requirement that controller or free-hand input in mid-air does not satisfy. To address this challenge, we bring rapid touch interaction on surfaces to Virtual Reality---the input modality that users have grown used to on phones and tablets for continued use. We present TapID, a wrist-based inertial sensing system that complements headset-tracked hand poses to trigger input in VR. TapID embeds a pair of inertial sensors in a flexible strap, one at either side of the wrist; from the combination of registered signals, TapID reliably detects surface touch events and, more importantly, identifies the finger used for touch. We evaluated TapID in a series of userstudies on event-detection accuracy (F1 = 0.997) and hand-agnostic finger-identification accuracy (within-user: F1 = 0.93; across users: F1 = 0.91 after 10 refinement taps and F1 = 0.87 without refinement) in a seated table scenario. We conclude with a series of applications that complement hand tracking with touch input and that are uniquely enabled by TapID, including UI control, rapid keyboard typing and piano playing, as well as surface gestures.

papers.title_en: PresenceBench: An Exploratory Evaluation of Large Language Model Adaptation to User State
papers.authors: Peña Arroyo Gallego, Mauro Ruiz Moreno, Alejandro Acien, Sergio Romero-Tapiador, Teresa Arroyo-Gallego
papers.evidence: 评估人工智能能否根据用户状态调整回应
papers.tldr: 大模型能否依据用户的准备度、心流与稳定性调整回答，同时保持质量和安全，尚缺乏可靠评测。本文提出PresenceBench，以五组因果对照区分模型是否利用状态，以及收益是否依赖正确状态。四个模型接收合成状态后的偏好胜率点估计均高于一半，但八个区间仅三个排除随机水平，状态特异性仍未确认。策略化输入减少成本与输出量，却未证明效率提升；贡献主要是评测工具与后续验证框架。
papers.abstract_en: Presence-aware intelligence is the capacity of an AI system's intelligence layer to adapt appropriately to the functional state of the person it serves (here readiness, flow, and stability) while preserving task quality and safety. We introduce PresenceBench, an instrument for measuring it. PresenceBench evaluates how the intelligence layer uses a supplied state, not how that state is sensed, and breaks the capability into measurable properties. Two are tested here. Receptivity: does the model take up the state and give a better response than with no signal? Specificity: does any improvement depend on the correct state, rather than on extra structured context? A third, adaptation across states, is a required endpoint not measured in this release. A five-arm causal design answers both questions, against each model's own baseline and an equally structured mismatched-state control, scored by a correctness-gated human paired comparison. The exploratory evaluation covered four models across eighteen single-turn, six fixed three-turn and six simulated natural-conversation scenarios. Supplying a synthetic state, raw or translated into a response policy, gave human-preference point estimates above 0.5 for all four models (Claude Sonnet 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Gemini 3.6 Flash, GPT-5.6 Terra), with three of eight 95% intervals excluding chance. Specificity was not resolved: no per-model interval excluded chance, and the design cannot yet separate the state values from a generic instruction to adapt. Policy delivery reduced priced cost and output tokens against each model's baseline; these are resource-use changes, not efficiency gains, because correctness non-inferiority was not established. Safety-floor failures were rare (13 of 360 cases), with a non-significant excess under policy delivery. We report the instrument, the frozen results, and the controls a confirmatory study needs.

papers.title_en: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
papers.authors: Jie Mao, Pingchen Lu, Xiangyi Wang, Hengquan Huang, Shuang Qiu, Min Zhang, Zhongxiang Dai
papers.evidence: 将用户对候选回答的轻量比较作为反馈来个性化智能体
papers.tldr: 大模型智能体的个性化需要随当前请求调整，但用户偏好往往隐含且反馈有限。ID-TAP将大规模离散人格选择建模为成对比较问题，结合查询条件化神经效用模型、轻量级Bradley–Terry探索器与相似度加权热启动，以兼顾偏好利用和信息探索。在七个用户条件化生成基准上，每次仅用十轮比较，其综合表现优于所评估基线。结果支持通过信息导向的挑战者选择，实现低交互成本的测试时人格适配。
papers.abstract_en: Effective test-time personalization requires LLM agents to adapt to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction. We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal. We present ID-TAP, a scalable, IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework for large discrete persona spaces. ID-TAP combines a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer, and transfers comparison evidence across related queries through similarity-weighted warm starts. The neural model shares statistical strength across queries while preserving query-specific scores, and efficient BT updates score hypothetical challengers. Across seven user-conditioned generation benchmarks under reference- and model-based preference simulators, ID-TAP achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated baselines within a fixed ten-round comparison budget. These results support information-directed challenger selection as an effective design for test-time persona adaptation.

papers.title_en: When Empathy Misses the Goal: A Benchmark for Goal Displacement in LLM Advice
papers.authors: Dean Ariel, Guy Laban
papers.evidence: 评测对话人工智能如何平衡共情、实际建议与用户目标
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的温暖回应未必推进用户目标，也可能用安慰替代实际帮助。论文提出目标置换基准GDB，覆盖九个领域、230个场景，以删除纯支持性语句后的实质内容评估回答。18个模型的4134条人工评分回答显示，陷阱场景置换率最高37.7%，反向置换率最高41.9%；后者指用户只求情感支持，模型却擅自提供方案。该基准将目标置换与迎合区分，为模型比较、后训练评估和回归测试提供工具。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational large language models can respond with warmth and reassurance while failing to advance the user's stated goal. We conceptualize this failure as $\textbf{goal displacement}$, the substitution of persona-maintenance content for goal-relevant substance. To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models. A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support. A deletion-test rubric assesses whether substantive help remains after purely supportive sentences are removed. Independent raters achieve weighted $κ= 0.82$ against author scores for displacement severity. Trap displacement ranges from $0.0\%$ to $37.7\%$ and is strongly negatively correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo ($ρ= -0.706$, $n = 15$). Reverse displacement reaches $41.9\%$, including substantial rates in models with negligible trap displacement. A factorial probe supports a distinction from social sycophancy. Human-scored responses in the high-complexity, low-pressure condition exhibit $35.0\%$ sycophancy but $7.5\%$ displacement, with little association between the constructs. Matched OLMo-2 checkpoints show that mixed empathy-with-constraints displacement remains at $52.3\%$ after supervised fine-tuning and falls to $13.8\%$ after direct preference optimization. GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing. We release the dataset, annotations, and rubric under CC-BY-4.0 and the evaluation code under MIT.

papers.title_en: Immersive Focus+Context Techniques to Assist in Interpretation of High Density Forest Point Clouds
papers.authors: Spencer O'Keeffe, Jan Rombouts, Bruce H Thomas, Michelle Balasso, Jim O'Hehir, Andrew Cunningham
papers.evidence: 通过用户研究设计并评估虚拟现实交互技术
papers.tldr: 高密度森林点云可支持林业资源管理，但复杂空间结构带来的尺度与可读性问题限制了分析效率。论文提出三种虚拟现实焦点加上下文技术，在抽象森林背景中保留用户控制的局部高细节区域。两项用户研究显示，虚拟现实在基础分析的耗时和准确率上优于桌面显示，所提技术在类实际林业任务中也显著优于现有方法。研究为兼顾局部细节与整体结构的沉浸式森林评估提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Virtual Reality (VR) is changing how we interact with complex spatial datasets. VR has the potential within forestry to help analyse remotely sensed spatial data for inventory management. However, challenges of scale and legibility of dense forest point clouds must be addressed. To do so, we present three VR Focus+Context (F+C) techniques: Wedgelight, Remote Lantern, and Ray Lantern. These techniques present point cloud data using a constrained highdetail focus within a broader abstracted context representation, manipulated using egocentric and exocentric interactions. We conducted two user studies. The first informed the design of the F+C techniques. The results from the first study indicate that VR significantly outperforms desktop displays in basic analysis of forestry point clouds, with improvements to both time and accuracy. The second study evaluated the performance of the resulting F+C techniques in a task analogous to real-world forestry operations. Our F+C techniques significantly outperformed current approaches, confirming their viability for facilitating detailed and effective forest assessments. These findings indicate that VR has significant advantages for spatial data analysis tasks in forestry, making a strong argument for its adoption in future analytical frameworks. The F+C visualisation techniques we introduced show considerable promise for analysis of high density point clouds, opening new avenues for development in immersive analytics. Supplemental materials (code, scans, results) are available at https://osf.io/hqc9u.

papers.title_en: An Interactive GraphRAG Workspace for Reifying, Auditing, and Steering Conversational AI Memories
papers.authors: Munshi Md Arafat Hussain, Md. Abdur Rahman, Md Saeed Siddik
papers.evidence: 交互式工作区支持用户审查并引导对话人工智能记忆
papers.tldr: 软件开发中的跨会话知识分散在线性聊天记录里，复用时容易遗漏架构依赖、引入过时接口，并造成提示膨胀。CognitiveCanvas将对话提炼为目标、事实和代码组成的分层语义图，结合多跳检索、时效审计与二维画布操作来组织和控制上下文。摘要报告词元减少92.2%，并支持对过时内容的一键纠正。其贡献是让对话记忆成为可持久保存、检查和操控的知识对象，但摘要未提供生成质量或用户效率的量化验证。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely employed in software engineering for code generation, debugging, and architectural design. However, as developers engage in multi-session development tasks, technical knowledge becomes siloed in isolated, linear chat histories. Reusing context across sessions leads to three critical challenges: (1) flat-vector retrieval fails to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies between distant architectural decisions; (2) temporal drift in software packages and APIs results in silent context poisoning when reusing aged dialogue logs; and (3) raw conversation concatenation induces prompt bloat and attention degradation.   We present CognitiveCanvas, an interactive tool that transforms conversational AI memories from ephemeral text logs into persistent, manipulable, and audited knowledge objects. \textsc{CognitiveCanvas} integrates: (1) a Hierarchical Semantic Fact-Graph (HSFG) that distills dialogues into Goal, Fact, and Code artifacts, achieving a 92.2\% token reduction while enabling multi-hop GraphRAG traversal; (2) a Continuous Temporal Drift Auditor coupling 60+ regex heuristics with live calendar-anchored LLM verification for 1-click self-correction; and (3) a Spatial-Symbolic Prompt Compiler (SSPC) that translates 2D direct manipulation gestures (Voronoi clustering, node resizing, synthesis edges) directly into structured attention directives

papers.title_en: VISTA: Steering LLMs with Latent User Values Inferred from a Few Survey Answers
papers.authors: Yinuo Xu, Jadie Adams, Brian Hu, Shivani Kumar, David Jurgens, Arslan Basharat
papers.evidence: 根据问卷答案推断个人价值观并用于模型对齐
papers.tldr: 语言模型个性化需要理解用户跨任务较稳定的价值观，但现有方法多依赖任务特定偏好或提示词画像。VISTA从少量问卷回答推断潜在价值画像，再通过超网络生成用户专属干预，引导冻结模型作答或生成文本。它在三个数据集上达到或超过提示词画像方法；在世界价值观调查中，仅询问6%的题目便保留完整问卷94%的增益。该方法无需增加提示词，并能自适应选题和停止，为低成本、面向个体的多元对齐提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing a language model requires knowing what a person values, which stays largely consistent across tasks. Yet most methods either learn task-specific preferences or place the user's profile in the prompt, where models struggle to act on it. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition), which infers a latent profile from users' (full or partial) survey answers, and maps the profile through a hypernetwork to a user-specific steering intervention in a frozen LLM to select answer choices or generate free-text responses. Given the same evidence, VISTA matches or beats in-context profiles on synthetic preferences (Food2D), the World Values Survey (WVS), and PrimeX, without adding prompt tokens. To reduce the cognitive burden of completing full surveys, VISTA also chooses which questions to ask and when to stop: on WVS it stops after 6% of the questionnaire while retaining 94% of the full-history gain, where standard adaptive testing retains at most 42%. The dominant steering direction is an interpretable value axis on which VISTA places unseen users accurately. Our results point toward pluralistic alignment that adapts to individuals at deployable cost.

papers.title_en: Agents' Last Doubt: Knowing When to Act and When to Step Back in Tool-Using Agents
papers.authors: Qisai Liu, Qingyue Jiao, Bangwei Guo, Wenxi Dai, Changyi Yang, Jiahe Liu, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Yiyu Shi, Zhanhong Jiang, Minghao Guo
papers.evidence: 研究智能体何时自主行动、继续询问或升级交由人类处理。
papers.tldr: 工具型智能体需在自主行动、获取信息与求助人类之间权衡，但现有轨迹只记录已选动作的结果，难以学习替代选择的价值。论文在ToolSandbox的1036个决策点执行各合法动作，收集3115个反事实结果，训练冻结主干模型之外的SURE-Act控制器。动作排序使离线效用较纯回归提高0.0309，Qwen3-4B端到端总分最高提高0.0575。该工作为兼顾任务成功、交互成本与不可逆错误提供了数据和决策方法。
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents repeatedly face decision points under uncertainty, choosing between autonomous action, additional information gathering, and human escalation. These decisions require balancing task success against interaction cost and the risk of irreversible errors. Learning to make these trade-offs is challenging because existing interaction trajectories record only the outcomes of actions taken, leaving the consequences of alternative actions unobserved. To address this gap, we construct a counterfactual dataset containing 3,115 action outcomes from 1,036 decision points in ToolSandbox. At each decision point, we execute each legal action and evaluate its downstream outcomes based on task completion, interaction cost, and irreversible errors. Using this dataset, we train SURE-Act, a controller that selects actions for a frozen backbone agent at inference time. Our experiments show that learning to rank alternative actions improves offline action-selection utility by 0.0309 over a regression-only baseline. We further show that adding SURE-Act enables end-to-end gains of up to 0.0575 in ToolSandbox's Overall Score with the Qwen3-4B agent. Moreover, SURE-Act outperforms adapted decision rules from SAGE-Agent and Calibrate-Then-Act by 0.1506 and 0.1438, respectively. This work establishes the first counterfactual dataset for ToolSandbox and provides actionable insights into decision-making under uncertainty for tool-using agents.

papers.title_en: RATION: Towards Quantitative Risk-Based Access Control for AI Agents
papers.authors: Yuntao Du, Harsh Chaudhari, Yuetian Chen, Ron Heichman, Ashish Jayamohan, Kumar Pallav, Mahim Patel, Kaiyuan Zhang, Kyle Polley, Jerry Ma, Ninghui Li
papers.evidence: 针对智能体执行用户任务时的意外行为与安全风险
papers.tldr: 人工智能智能体在外部环境中执行复杂任务时，容易遭遇间接提示注入，而单纯限制行动会牺牲任务效用。RATION以可量化的累计风险为访问控制依据，结合用户请求中的显式约束与相似任务历史执行校准的隐式风险，生成任务专属策略。执行期间持续追踪风险，并按风险类型实施差异化约束。四个安全基准上的实验表明，该框架在不同模型和环境中兼顾较强安全性与较高任务效用，为智能体访问控制提供了量化治理路径。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly interact with external environments to complete complex user tasks. These interactions can lead to unexpected behavior and expose agents to security threats such as indirect prompt injection. Current agent security systems largely protect agents by restricting their actions, which can result in a substantial security-utility trade-off for complex, open-ended tasks. To address this, we propose a quantitative risk-based approach to access control for AI agents that regulates measurable risks accumulated during task execution. As a concrete realization of this approach, we introduce RATION, a security framework that tracks measurable risks associated with agent actions and enforces quantitative constraints throughout execution. RATION first constructs a task-specific policy by combining explicit constraints derived from the user request with implicit risks calibrated from historical executions of similar tasks. During task execution, RATION continuously tracks the accumulated risks and applies different enforcement strategies depending on the type of risk. Extensive experiments on four security benchmarks show that RATION provides strong security while maintaining high task utility across diverse models and environments.

papers.title_en: Ask Less, Ask Better: Allocating User Attention in Proactive LLM Agents with Interruption Budgets
papers.authors: Xuanming Zhang, Amir H. Rezaeian, Miguel Ballesteros, Weiyi Sun, Werner Geyer, Lydia B. Chilton, Zhou Yu, Yassine Benajiba, Dan Roth
papers.evidence: 以用户注意力成本和感知交互负担评估智能体提问
papers.tldr: 主动式语言模型代理通过提问澄清需求，但仅统计问题数量无法反映用户负担。论文将限制提问次数的中断预算，与衡量阅读难度和提问必要性的用户注意力成本结合，并利用历史回答审查候选问题。在八个模型、四个客服领域中，限制提问一至三次可降低注意力成本36%—73%，保留86%—94%的任务奖励；记忆引导审查进一步降低成本13%。研究表明，少问与问好是不同目标，代理评估应同时衡量任务收益和注意力消耗。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can ask clarifying questions to complete tasks, but answering each question demands users' time and effort. Existing evaluations typically measure this burden by counting questions, treating necessary and avoidable questions equally. We propose an evaluation protocol that distinguishes how often agents ask from how well they ask. An interruption budget limits the number of questions, while a user-attention cost charges extra for questions that are hard to read or not worth asking, as rated by a human-validated LLM judge. Beyond question counts, this cost captures perceived effort: on conversation pairs with the same number of questions, human annotators agreed with the cost on which conversation required more effort 75% of the time. Across eight LLMs and four customer-service domains, limiting agents to one to three questions reduces user-attention cost by 36-73% while keeping 86-94% of the task reward they earn with unlimited questions. At the same budget, reviewing each question against the memory of users' earlier answers cuts attention cost by another 13% with little reward loss and yields more valuable questions. Models also differ sharply in how well they ask: at the same user-attention cost, the most efficient models gain more than twice as much reward from their questions as the others. These results show that asking less and asking better are distinct goals, and that evaluations of proactive agents should measure both.

papers.title_en: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
papers.authors: Junming Zhang, Rubin Wei, Xu Cheng, Hao Sun, Ruoxi Cheng, Xiquan Wang, Peisong Wu, Mingsong Chen, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 评估长期智能体记忆对用户习惯的推断与应用
papers.tldr: 长期交互中，用户习惯往往隐含于零散选择与行动，保存历史并不等于能正确归纳和应用习惯。HABIT-Bench基于任务型对话与受控习惯图构造跨数百会话的合成历史，以四选一任务覆盖四个领域，并考察临时例外、习惯变化及未被采纳的建议。在两种模型上评估八种记忆方法，最佳跨领域宏平均准确率仅为33.61%，直接提供标注证据后表现仍有限。结果揭示了历史信息可用与习惯推断、恰当应用之间的持续差距。
papers.abstract_en: In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly. These results expose a persistent gap between access to past interactions and the ability to infer and appropriately use user habits.

papers.title_en: Leveraging Mental Models for Human-Centered Explanations: A Systematic Design Approach Illustrated by Explainable Fake Review Identification
papers.authors: Sidra Naveed, Md Shajalal, Gunnar Stevens, Alexander Boden
papers.evidence: 以用户心智模型为依据设计可理解的人工智能解释
papers.tldr: 现有可解释人工智能常重视模型忠实度，却难以帮助普通用户理解判断依据。论文提出MIND-X，以虚假评论识别为案例，通过10人定性研究提取用户判断可信度的线索，再将其转化为设计原则，指导大语言模型生成自然语言解释。166人定量评估显示，相比词元级透明性方法，该方案在可理解性、满意度、感知信任、说服力和决策支持方面具有优势。研究强调贴合用户心智模型的设计价值，而非宣称解释方法普遍更优。
papers.abstract_en: Explainable AI (XAI) often prioritizes model fidelity over user intelligibility, yielding explanations that satisfy technical transparency yet fail to support human sense-making. We propose a human-centered approach, MIND-X (Mental-model INtegrated Design for eXplainability), which aligns explanations with users' mental models, commonsense concepts, and judgment heuristics. Using fake review detection as a case study, we contribute: (1) a qualitative study (n=10) that elicits how people assess review credibility and produces an actionable, design-guiding taxonomy of perceptual cues; (2) a set of design principles that link those cues to explanation strategies and prompt LLMs to generate adaptive, language-based explanations; and (3) a quantitative evaluation (n=166) showing that these explanations offer distinct advantages over token-level transparency methods widely used in explainable text classification in terms of understandability, satisfaction, perceived trust, persuasiveness, and decision-making support. Rather than claiming general superiority, our evaluation illustrates how grounding explanations in users' everyday reasoning practices can produce more intelligible and context-sensitive accounts. Our findings advance human-centered explanation design beyond a mere "gloss of transparency," demonstrating that a mental-model-aligned design process can improve intelligibility and support accountability across user-centered explanation tasks.

papers.title_en: Ego2Contact: Predicting Touch from Egocentric Human Video for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Qianqian Yang, Dayou Li, Bangya Liu, Zihao Zhu, Nuo Chen, Siyuan Xu, Hezhen Hu, Chen Yu, Rebecca Friesen, Minghui Zheng, Cynthia Hipwell, Xiaoning Qian, Kenji Shimada, Zhiwen Fan
papers.evidence: 预测机器人操作中的触觉接触位置与作用力
papers.tldr: 接触丰富的机器人操作依赖接触位置与作用力，但机器人触觉数据稀缺，人类第一视角视频又缺少触觉信号。Ego2Contact从人类视觉—触觉配对数据学习先验，融合时序场景与手部局部特征，并通过解剖区域对应将双手触觉预测迁移至机器人。其在人类数据、未见物体及适配后的机器人数据上优于既有预测器；仿真策略使用预测触觉后优于无触觉基线，获得部分真实触觉收益。该方法为触觉传感受限的机器人提供了可迁移的触觉输入。
papers.abstract_en: Contact locations and interaction forces are critical for contact-rich robot manipulation but are often ambiguous from vision alone. Measuring them on robots requires specialized tactile hardware and platform-specific data collection, which keeps robot tactile data scarce. Human egocentric video is far easier to scale but lacks touch. Recent predictors trained on egocentric recordings paired with tactile-glove measurements can predict this missing signal from video alone. These predictors, however, remain confined to human hands, which differ from robot hands in appearance and tactile layout. We present Ego2Contact, which learns a visual-tactile prior from human interactions and transfers it to robot hands. Its predictor fuses temporal scene context with hand-local visual features to infer bimanual tactile fields from the RGB video. Anatomical region correspondences align varying robot tactile layouts with the predictor's canonical grid, turning robot measurements into fine-tuning targets and predictions into policy inputs. Ego2Contact outperforms prior tactile predictors on human data, including unseen objects, and on robot data after adaptation. The adapted predictor provides tactile inputs for both simulated reinforcement learning and real-robot policy post-training. In simulation, policies using predicted touch outperform non-tactile baselines and recover part of the benefit of ground-truth tactile sensing. These results show that human-learned tactile priors can supply touch when direct tactile sensing is limited.

papers.title_en: What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks
papers.authors: Dawei Li, Bohan Jiang, Huan Liu
papers.evidence: 讨论反复使用AI如何累积影响独立判断、观点和易受影响程度。
papers.tldr: 现有人工智能安全讨论侧重灾难性事件，却可能忽略日常使用中逐步累积的伤害。本文借鉴社交媒体研究，提出“轨迹忽视论”，分析重复互动、社会强化与个体易感性如何形成长期反馈。以对话式人工智能为例，指出生成、语义推断和持久记忆可能使迎合、操纵与隐私流失相互强化，但并未证明重复使用必然有害。文章倡议将安全评估从单次事件扩展到长期使用轨迹、跨部署反馈及个体与社会后果，并采取适度防护。
papers.abstract_en: Prominent AI safety discussions emphasize existential threats and catastrophic events, such as AI-enabled nuclear conflict or engineered biological outbreaks. This position paper argues that there is another type of AI risk that arises and accumulates from the widespread use of AI. Drawing on lessons from social media, we argue that safety assessments must also address accumulative harms that develop through repeated use, recurring decisions, and feedback across interconnected deployments. Repeated reassurance, selective exposure, recurring decision biases, and growing personal profiles may gradually narrow perspectives, weaken independent judgment, or enable exploitative influence without a single clearly harmful event. We advance the Trajectory Neglect Thesis: a focus on vivid catastrophic events and identifiable incidents risks overlooking less visible harms that accumulate through the widespread daily use of AI. Social media research motivates this position by showing how reciprocal media effects, social reinforcement, and individual susceptibility shape outcomes beyond individual encounters. We examine how related mechanisms may operate in AI systems, using conversational AI as a concrete setting where generation, semantic inference, and persistent memory may tighten feedback loops. Sycophancy, manipulation, and privacy loss provide a case study of how these risks may interact and accumulate. This comparison identifies mechanisms to investigate rather than assuming that repeated AI use is harmful. We therefore call for evaluation of cumulative patterns of use and deployment, individual and societal outcomes, careful causal inference, and proportionate safeguards that preserve useful assistance and informed user choice.

papers.title_en: SynerGest: Temporal-Spatial Synergistic Gesture Generation for Dyadic Conversations
papers.authors: Chengxiang Guo, Jian Wang, Lanmiao Liu, Zhan Tang, Junhua Fei, Xiao Li
papers.evidence: 为虚拟化身生成对话手势，属于多模态交互能力。
papers.tldr: 双人对话中的伴随语音手势生成，往往难以兼顾动作稳定性与节奏响应，并因语义纠缠出现平均姿态或微小抖动。SynerGest引入对比流匹配，通过惩罚语义不匹配的样本对增强条件对齐；同时以脉冲—趋势协同注意力分离语音节奏脉冲与连续运动趋势。作者报告，该方法在两个公开数据集上达到最先进水平，兼顾音频—动作同步与运动流畅性。其贡献在于协同建模动作内容和发生时机，为自然双人虚拟交互提供生成框架。
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech gesture generation in dyadic conversations for creating immersive virtual avatars remains highly challenging. Existing models often struggle to balance kinematic stability with rhythmic responsiveness and suffer from semantic entanglement, leading to either generic mean-pose regression or unnatural micro-jitters. To address these challenges, we propose SynerGest, a high-fidelity dyadic gesture generation framework grounded in Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM). Specifically, our CFM objective explicitly penalizes mismatched semantic pairs during training, discouraging spatial shortcuts and over-smoothed predictions while improving conditional semantic alignment. Furthermore, to overcome architectural bottlenecks, we introduce the Impulse-Trend Synergistic Attention (ITSA) module. Grounded in the key insight of decoupling "what moves" from "when it moves," ITSA models sharp, speech-driven rhythmic impulses separately from continuous kinematic trends, supporting precise audio-motion synchronization and global structural stability. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations on two public datasets demonstrate that SynerGest achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering contextually responsive and kinematically fluid dyadic interactions.

papers.title_en: Can LLM Agents Resolve Service Failures? Simulating Multi-Turn Complaint Handling under Information Asymmetry
papers.authors: Wailing Ng, Mengze Hong, Chen Jason Zhang, Shiqi Fan
papers.evidence: 评估服务聊天机器人处理高情绪负荷、多轮投诉对话的能力。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型已广泛用于客服，但情绪复杂的投诉处理仍依赖人工。论文提出投诉处理基准ServiceBench，包含五个服务行业、184类投诉和2500个场景，并以信息不对称的渐进式多轮模拟及公平理论框架评估处理质量。实验发现，强模型仍缺乏主动询问和策略性引导能力，常过早提出补偿。针对性的监督微调与偏好优化显著改善这些能力，使小模型在多项结果上追平或超过更大模型，为投诉客服的评测与训练提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are widely adopted in service chatbots for rule-guided support and information access, yet emotionally demanding complaint handling still relies heavily on human agents. We introduce ServiceBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to complaint handling, with 2,500 scenarios spanning 184 complaint categories and five service industries. We propose Asymmetric Progressive Complaint Simulation (APCS) to simulate realistic complaint handling, together with a justice-based evaluation framework. Our experiments reveal that even capable LLM agents struggle to handle complaints effectively. They lack the ability to proactively gather information and strategically guide conversations toward resolution, often resorting to premature compensation. We further show that targeted post-training with SFT and DPO substantially improves these capabilities, enabling a smaller model to match or surpass much larger models on several outcomes.

papers.title_en: Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Peijun Shi, Xiujin Zhu, Zhenguo Lao, Chee-Onn Chow, Wei Ru Wong, Zhen Liu, Xiaobing Jiang
papers.evidence: 融合脑电与眼动信号进行情绪识别，可用于心理健康监测
papers.tldr: 脑电与眼动融合可用于情绪识别，但现有模型常忽略模态差异与时间上下文，且易受眼动缺失影响。CTD-GNet以脑电电极构图，用眼动和历史窗口调节图结构，并通过双向蒸馏训练单窗口脑电学生。其在SEED和SEED-IV留一受试者测试中准确率达84.91%和76.17%，均居首位，且跨受试者表现更稳定。该方法将眼动作为脑电交互的调节信息，同时提升融合识别与缺失模态下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: EEG-eye movement emotion recognition can support mental-health monitoring and adaptive interfaces, but most fusion models treat the two signals as parallel features, classify each window alone and degrade when eye data are lost. We propose the Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network (CTD-GNet), in which EEG features form the nodes of an electrode graph, and eye movements and preceding windows modulate its edges, nodes and readout, the edges through electrode-specific prompts. Bidirectional distillation of the graph, node relations and predictions couples this multimodal teacher with a single-window EEG student, improving the teacher and aligning the two graphs 35-fold. In leave-one-subject-out tests on SEED and SEED-IV against 17 baselines, CTD-GNet has the highest mean accuracy, 84.91% and 76.17%, significantly above 9 and 6 of 13 eye-based baselines after Holm correction, the smallest cross-subject spread among multimodal models and the highest worst-subject accuracy. It is the most accurate model at every rate of missing eye data on SEED-IV, keeps 66.1% on SEED without eye data, more than any EEG-only model, and stays 9.3 and 11.9 points above all single-window fusion models under eye-movement noise of one standard deviation. On film clips unseen in training, it leads on SEED with 77.1%.

papers.title_en: Autonomous intelligence for mining productivity: a multi-agent AI approach to operational value creation
papers.authors: N Guerin, A Dehoux, M Nakhla
papers.evidence: 在安全关键运营中整合智能体编排与人机界面
papers.tldr: 矿业综合远程运营中心走向自主化，既缺少统筹工业系统的智能体架构，也缺少兼顾安全、实时性与成本的评测体系。论文提出三层多智能体架构EI2ROC，由大语言模型协调监测和产能预测智能体，并通过工具接口交互。研究还提出包含场景库、测试环境、指标与人工校准协议的评测框架，报告运营现场的初步成本和延迟观察，但摘要未给出量化结果。其贡献是提供面向资本密集型工业的设计与评测蓝图，而非验证全面自主运营。
papers.abstract_en: Integrated Remote Operation Centres (IROCs) are emerging as the architectural frontier of Industry 4.0 for capital-intensive sectors such as mining, oil and gas, and energy. Yet two intertwined gaps constrain their evolution towards full autonomy. First, no integrated agentic architecture has been proposed for mining IROCs that orchestrates Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition systems, digital twins, predictive analytics and human-machine interfaces under safety-critical constraints. Second, no evaluation framework jointly addresses the real-time, Health-Safety-Environment, regulatory-auditability and cost-per-decision requirements that govern industrial agentic deployments. This paper makes four contributions. It synthesises industry needs and quantified gains documented in analogous industries that motivate an agentic approach to mining IROCs. It introduces EI2ROC, a three-tier multi-agent architecture combining a Large Language Model orchestrator with specialised monitoring and production-capacityprediction agents communicating through a Model Context Protocol-style tool interface. It provides a critical review of agentic evaluation along six orthogonal dimensions and identifies the industrial blind spot of current benchmarks. Finally, it proposes a multi-dimensional benchmarking framework for industrial agentic AI comprising scenario library, harness, metrics and humancalibration protocol. The paper states explicitly which components are implemented in the current prototype, which belong to the proposed reference design and which remain future work, and reports preliminary cost and latency observations from an operating site. Together, EI2ROC and the benchmarking framework constitute a methodological blueprint transferable across CAPEX intensive industries.

papers.title_en: Friends as Sensors: High-Sensitivity Monitoring of Misinformation and Platform Dynamics via the Friendship Paradox
papers.authors: Angermaier Mathias, Lasser Jana, Lewandowsky Stephan, Garcia David
papers.evidence: 分析社交平台上的错误信息与内容可见度变化
papers.tldr: 社交平台需要更早发现错误信息，并监测内容曝光变化。研究利用友谊悖论，将随机用户转推的账号作为传感器，比较美国2024年大选期间两组约2700万与3100万条推文。传感器发布的新闻质量与随机用户相近，但带有新闻质量评级的链接提前到达，中位领先70分钟；其右翼内容单条推文曝光量约增至2.5倍，随机组未见同样变化。这种采样不能区分新闻质量，却可提供新闻早期预警并追踪平台可见性变化。
papers.abstract_en: The friends of a randomly chosen social media user are, on average, better connected than the user, a network property known as the friendship paradox. We use it to monitor misinformation on Twitter/X around the 2024 US election, comparing roughly 27 million tweets from random users with 31 million from the accounts they retweet, which we call sensors. Sensors share news of about the same quality as random users, because news quality follows the political orientation of linked outlets and not the user's position in the network. News links rated by NewsGuard reach sensors a median of 70 minutes earlier, across the quality spectrum. Over the election window, right-leaning content rises about 2.5-fold in visibility, measured as impressions per tweet, among sensors but not among random users. Friendship-paradox sampling therefore cannot separate low-quality from high-quality news, but it detects news early and tracks what a platform makes visible.

papers.title_en: Encounter-Driven City-Scale Human Mobility Generation with Large Language Models
papers.authors: Chao Li, Renhe Jiang, Chuan Xiao, Jiawei Wang
papers.evidence: 用大模型框架模拟群体相遇与交互结构
papers.tldr: 现有大语言模型出行生成方法侧重个人轨迹，难以还原居民在同一时间、地点相遇的群体结构。EncounterMob先由粗到细生成城市相遇事件，再迭代协调事件与个人出行，并评估相遇的边缘及联合分布。在日本和纽约数据集上，其七项相遇指标与六项个人出行指标均优于外部基线；相较ELLMob，参与者—时间—地点联合误差分别降低40.4%和41.7%。该研究将出行合成从个体行为拟真推进到群体共现结构保真。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for human mobility generation by modeling individual routines, activities, and mobility preferences. However, existing approaches remain largely resident-centric: generating realistic individual trajectories does not necessarily recover the encounters that emerge when multiple residents co-occur at the same place and time. To this end, we study encounter-aware human mobility generation, which jointly preserves individual mobility and population-level interaction structure. We propose EncounterMob, an encounter-driven LLM framework consisting of a coarse-to-fine Encounter Generator and an Iterative Coupling Framework. The Encounter Generator first captures city-level encounter rhythms and then instantiates participant-time-venue encounters, while the Iterative Coupling Framework coordinates these encounters with personal mobility behavior through successive refinement. We further introduce an encounter recovery protocol covering encounter marginal and joint distributions over residents, times, and venues. Experiments on the Japan and NYC datasets show that EncounterMob outperforms all external baselines on all seven encounter metrics and all six personal mobility metrics. Compared with ELLMob, it reduces the participant-time-venue joint error by 40.4%/41.7% and the mean personal mobility error by 58.8%/32.7% on Japan/NYC, respectively.

papers.title_en: MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots
papers.authors: Mohamed Abouagour, Junhyun Nam, Wonse Jo, Byung-Cheol Min
papers.evidence: 指令驱动机器人随环境变化增量维护目标判断
papers.tldr: 机器人持续执行语言指令时，环境变化并不意味着所有房间的缓存判断都需重算。MIND将指令编译为语义资格与目标选择依赖，按事件影响范围仅刷新相关判断，并分别更新可达性与目标选择。在240组五事件序列中，平均语义评估次数从30.6降至11.2，全部1200次事件后决策与全量重算一致。该方法在明确假设下保持决策等价，并获闭环仿真与实体机器人验证，但不提升评估器本身的任务准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18. Additional materials are available at https://mind-icra27.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Model What Matters: Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling for Language Agents
papers.authors: Maolin Ran, Minda Chen, Di Huang, Wei Xiong, Fei Huang, Weiwen Liu
papers.evidence: 为大语言模型智能体在环境中的行动提供决策导向建模
papers.tldr: 语言智能体的强化学习奖励通常稀疏，难以直接教会模型理解动作后果，而完整观测建模又会混入与决策无关的信息。DGS-WM筛选能支持后续策略响应的观测单元，并按预测置信度自适应调整监督强度，与强化学习联合训练同一策略模型。在单跳、多跳问答及交互式网页任务中，该方法跨模型规模和强化学习算法均取得一致改进，优于完整观测建模。其贡献是让辅助世界建模聚焦决策价值，而非无差别预测环境信息。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. DGS-WM employs a Decision-Guided Observation Selection component that filters observation units with decision value as world modeling targets based on their support for subsequent policy responses, and a Confidence-Adaptive Weighting component that adaptively adjusts supervision strength according to the model's prediction confidence on selected targets. Together, these components form a decision-aware auxiliary world modeling loss, jointly optimized with the RL loss on the same policy model. Across multiple benchmarks covering single-hop/multi-hop question answering and interactive web tasks, DGS-WM achieves consistent improvements under different model scales and RL algorithms, demonstrating more stable and effective performance compared to full-observation world modeling methods.

papers.title_en: Emotion Is Not External Knowledge: Internal Attention Signals for Affective State Reasoning
papers.authors: Wenqiu Tang, Zhen Wan, Yihui Wang, Takahiro Komamizu, Ichiro Ide
papers.evidence: 多轮对话中追踪潜在情绪状态
papers.tldr: 多轮对话中的情绪线索可能在话题切换后仍然有效，模型的难点是利用已有证据，而非补充外部知识。论文提出SIAB，通过激活修补定位稀疏情绪注意力头，并在作答位置增强其已关注的内容词元。在三个大模型、两个基准上，相对匹配提示基线，宏平均F1最高提升10.3和5.5个百分点；结合外部监督后还可进一步增益。结果表明，模型内部信号可用于情绪证据路由，并与外部引导互补。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate in multi-turn interactions that require maintaining latent conversational states, not only explicit facts. We study affective state as an implicit state inferred from sparse contextual cues that remain relevant after topic shifts, and ask whether LLMs expose internal attention signals for routing such evidence at inference time. Prior attention interventions rely on labeled in-domain head profiles and externally specified target spans, limiting transfer across affective-evidence distributions. We propose Self-targeted Internal Attention Boosting (SIAB), which localizes sparse affective heads via causal localization (in detail activation patching) on synthetic minimal pairs and boosts, at the answer position, the content tokens these heads already attend to; both edited heads and target tokens are derived from the model's own behavior, enabling the same head set to be reused across tasks.We evaluate on ECC and GoEmotions across three LLMs and multiple prompting settings. Across settings, SIAB improves prompt-matched baselines by up to +10.3 macro-F1 on ECC and +5.5 on GoEmotions. Combined with PASTA-style external supervision, it achieves up to +13.84 accuracy points and +12.51 macro-F1 points, while mechanistic analyses trace the gains to sparse, emotion-enriched heads and show that layer proximity affects additivity.

papers.title_en: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
papers.authors: Sebastian-Antonio Toma, Jean de Kernier, Mike Ply, Oliviu Matei
papers.evidence: 提出用于诊断智能体记忆可靠性的评测基准。
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆评测依赖下游问答，混淆了记忆、检索与生成质量，既可能掩盖错误记忆，也可能误判正确记忆。论文提出FEB-30，从已知事实演化轨迹生成文档，逐步直接检查记忆库，覆盖6类诊断场景和3档难度。在一个代表性系统上，内外部评测平均相差16个百分点，记忆操作分类正确率仅20%。研究表明，直接检查记忆状态可揭示问答评分遗漏的缺陷，并提供开放基准、生成流水线与评分框架。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.
